most_useful_features.description: Additive model of single-gene responses: the sum over p's target genes of each gene's single-gene training response (the mean response of the other training perturbations whose one target is that gene), with the mean single-gene training response for a gene without one.

Low-rank response components of the training perturbations (leave-one-out SVD of their centred delta profiles); p's weight on each component is predicted by kernel ridge from its target's annotations (gene-set memberships, protein interactions, TF-network partners). One column per component.

Kernel transfer through an external screen (knowledge file replogle2022_k562): kernel ridge regression over the other training perturbations' responses, kernel = Pearson correlation between the external responses of their targets, so p's response is the mean training response plus a signed mix of the others' deviations from it; lambda chosen by leave-one-out over those training perturbations; the mean training response when p's target has no external row or fewer than 3 training perturbations have one.
Response of g averaged over the k training perturbations whose targets are most co-expressed with p's targets (leave-one-out).

Neighbour transfer through an external screen (knowledge file replogle2022_k562): weighted mean of the other training perturbations' responses, weights = correlation between the external responses of their targets and p's target, top k positive; the mean training response when p's target has no external row or no positively correlated neighbour.

External screen response of p's target (knowledge file replogle2022_k562): the change of gene g measured for the same target gene in another screen of the cell line (for a pair, the sum of its genes' rows), times the file's sign; 0 where unmeasured or without a row.
Control mean expression of g if g is the perturbed target, else 0.
Control-cell correlation between the perturbed target gene and gene g.
Control-cell standard deviation of gene g.
